messages:
Alex K: Heads-up — we're scheduling a staggered interconnect firmware update in apac-west1 on Sat 2026-03-28 02:00-05:00 UTC. Expected node reboots across 3 cohorts. Impact: short (<90s) NIC reset per node, but rolling drains may reduce GPU pool capacity by ~18-22% during the window. Runbook: https://runbook.internal/ops/apac-interconnect-fw

Maria L: Can you paste cohort list + CIDR? Need to check customer reservations.

Alex K: Cohorts: cohort-a (nodes a101-a130) 02:00-03:00, cohort-b (a131-a160) 03:00-04:00, cohort-c (a161-a190) 04:00-05:00. CIDRs: 10.40.0.0/24, 10.40.1.0/24, 10.40.2.0/24. Plan: cordon -> drain with KV pre-seed, reboot, uncordon + KV validation. We'll run canaries first (2 nodes).

Kenji: Ops question — can we backfill from us-east burst pool if we hit >20% capacity loss? Rough cost estimate ~ $1.2k/hr for reserved burst GPUs or $600/hr with spot.

Priya S: Oncall this week — @sre-oncall, can you hold traffic pushback for cohort-b? Also notify CS for customers on dedicated capacity (we should surface the window).

sre-bot: maintenance-ticket #INC-9482 created. Pager scheduled for 02:50 UTC. Runbook link: https://runbook.internal/ops/apac-interconnect-fw

Alex K: Runbook snippet:
```
# drain node example
kubectl cordon node-a101
kubectl drain node-a101 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=60
# kv preseed
/opt/scripts/kv-preseed.sh --nodes node-a101,node-a102
```
KV preseed must complete before uncordon.

Maria L: Suggest adding a short-lived routing policy to route heavy/latency-sensitive customers to eu fallback during cohort windows. Also mark dedicated tenants in the schedule so CS can trigger manual failover if asked.

Kenji: Agree. Also plan to bump autoscaler min by +10% across regional pools 30m before each cohort. We'll accept the cost hit.

Priya S: I'll draft customer-facing blurb and post to #customer-success in 20m. cc @Maria L

Alex K: Canary timeline: 02:00-02:12 small batch -> verify perf and KV hit ratio -> proceed. Abort criteria: error rate >2% or p95 latency spike >100ms. Rollback: reflash previous image and stop remaining cohorts. Fallback: route to eu + spin spot backfill.

Maria L: +1. Add metric checks: p50 latency, p95 latency, 5xx rate, KV hitrate, queue depth.

Kenji: I'll pre-approve $3k emergency budget for spot backfill if needed — ops_lead please sign off on final spend after window.

Priya S: Tagging ops lead for final signoff @ops_lead

ops_lead: signoff. Keep me posted on real-time metrics. Escalate immediately if capacity loss >15% for more than 10 minutes.

Alex K: Will post CRON schedule and kick off the preflight 1 hour prior. Reminder: KV pre-seed must run before we uncordon. If any node fails to reboot after 4 minutes, escalate to hardware oncall. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance created in company calendar: 2026-03-28T02:00Z-05:00Z

sre-bot: Update: canary passed at 02:12 UTC. Proceeding to cohort-b per runbook.

Kenji: Noted. I'll start the autoscaler bump at 02:40 UTC.

Priya S: Draft posted to #customer-success (link: https://cs.internal/msg/abc123).

Alex K: Final note — document actual capacity delta in the post-mortem (include token throughput, GPU utilization, and additional cost incurred for backfill). I'll start a post-mortem thread after the window.
